{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] px = a ^ b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] eqp = ~px;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ga = a & b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gab = (~a) & b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gba = a & (~b);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ca, bab, bba;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result = px ^ ca;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ab_result = px ^ bab;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ba_result = px ^ bba;

    pw_alu_carry4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_add (.p(px), .g(ga), .c(ca));
    pw_alu_carry4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_ab (.p(eqp), .g(gab), .c(bab));
    pw_alu_carry4 #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_ba (.p(eqp), .g(gba), .c(bba));

    wire s_add = (Oper == 3'b000);
    wire s_ab  = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire s_ba  = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire s_or  = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire s_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire s_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire s_xnr = (Oper == 3'b110);

    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{s_add}} & add_result)
            | ({WIDTH{s_ab}}  & ab_result)
            | ({WIDTH{s_ba}}  & ba_result)
            | ({WIDTH{s_or}}  & (a | b))
            | ({WIDTH{s_and}} & ga)
            | ({WIDTH{s_xor}} & px)
            | ({WIDTH{s_xnr}} & eqp);
    end
endmodule

module pw_alu_carry4 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] p,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] g,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] c
);
    localparam GROUPS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(GROUPS);
    localparam PAD = GROUPS * 4;
    wire [PAD-1:0] pp, gg;
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gg_prefix [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] boundary;

    genvar i, k, l;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD; i = i + 1) begin: pad_bits
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign pp[i] = p[i];
                assign gg[i] = g[i];
            end else begin: unused_bit
                assign pp[i] = 1'b1;
                assign gg[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k + 1) begin: group_terms
            assign gp[0][k] = &pp[4*k +: 4];
            assign gg_prefix[0][k] = gg[4*k+3]
                | (pp[4*k+3] & gg[4*k+2])
                | (pp[4*k+3] & pp[4*k+2] & gg[4*k+1])
                | (pp[4*k+3] & pp[4*k+2] & pp[4*k+1] & gg[4*k]);
        end
        for (l = 0; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin: prefix_level
            for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k + 1) begin: prefix_node
                if (k >= (1 << l)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k] & gp[l][k-(1 << l)];
                    assign gg_prefix[l+1][k] = gg_prefix[l][k]
                        | (gp[l][k] & gg_prefix[l][k-(1 << l)]);
                end else begin: pass_through
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k];
                    assign gg_prefix[l+1][k] = gg_prefix[l][k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k + 1) begin: group_boundary
            if (k == 0) begin: first
                assign boundary[k] = 1'b0;
            end else begin: later
                assign boundary[k] = gg_prefix[LEVELS][k-1];
            end
        end
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin: bit_carry
            if ((i % 4) == 0) begin: offset0
                assign c[i] = boundary[i/4];
            end else if ((i % 4) == 1) begin: offset1
                assign c[i] = gg[i-1] | (pp[i-1] & boundary[i/4]);
            end else if ((i % 4) == 2) begin: offset2
                assign c[i] = gg[i-1]
                    | (pp[i-1] & gg[i-2])
                    | (pp[i-1] & pp[i-2] & boundary[i/4]);
            end else begin: offset3
                assign c[i] = gg[i-1]
                    | (pp[i-1] & gg[i-2])
                    | (pp[i-1] & pp[i-2] & gg[i-3])
                    | (pp[i-1] & pp[i-2] & pp[i-3] & boundary[i/4]);
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse long arithmetic carry logic and the final operation-selection network. The three arithmetic operations can also duplicate operand preprocessing and sum-generation logic.",
  "rewrite": "Use three parallel, explicitly bounded-depth carry/borrow networks. Each network forms four-bit group generate/propagate terms and a logarithmic parallel-prefix tree across groups, followed by short local lookahead. Subtraction uses direct borrow generation with equality propagation, sharing the operand XOR with addition and logical operations. Decode Oper into mutually exclusive output masks; keep operation selection out of the carry paths.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The structural target is lower arrival than the measured 3.00 ns baseline by replacing long mapped carry paths with four prefix levels across sixteen groups at WIDTH=64. A quantitative gain is not established without running the specified mapping, STA, and electrical checks.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Three parallel carry/borrow trees trade some prefix wiring and group logic for reduced depth. Shared XOR, equality, and AND terms limit duplication. No registers or latency are added. Compliance with the 13121.834880 um2 area cap and library electrical limits requires measurement; no mapped results are claimed.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves pw_alu ports, unsigned vector interpretation, WIDTH parameter, and WIDTH-bit modular arithmetic. Operations 000 through 110 retain their original meanings; 111 produces all zeros. Borrow-in and carry-in are zero. Partial final groups are padded with identity propagate/generate values, supporting positive WIDTH values including nonmultiples of four. The supplied module has no CRC ports or state, and none are introduced. Equivalence is intended for every binary input combination, without assumptions, state, latches, or added latency."
}
